title: Kiwifruit response to Pseudomonas syringae
author: Yalin Song
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wziff4e
materials: KOBAS software was used to test the enrichment of DEGs in KEGG (Kyoto Encyclopedia of Gene and Genomes) pathways .
qRT-PCR was performed on a RT-PCR instrument (Roche 480, Basle, Switzerland).
The 2×SYBR Green I RT-PCR Master Mix (Roche) was used as a fluorescent reporter.

steps.title: Culture and Prepare Psa
steps.instruction: Culture Pseudomonas syringae (Psa) and adjust the concentration for inoculation.

substeps.instruction: Culture Psa on beef peptone medium for 24 h at 20°C.
Dilute the microbial concentration of Psa to 10^8 colony-forming units (cfu)/ml.

steps.title: Prepare Detached Shoots
steps.instruction: Sterilize and prepare kiwifruit shoots for inoculation.

substeps.instruction: Surface sterilize detached shoots with chlorine.
Cut shoots into 10 cm lengths.
Dip the ends of the shoots in candle wax to reduce dehydration.

steps.title: Inoculate Shoots
steps.instruction: Inoculate the prepared shoots with Psa.

substeps.instruction: Create a wound with a file approximately 1-1.5 cm from each end of the shoot.
Add Psa to the wound using a pipette.

steps.title: Incubate Inoculated Shoots
steps.instruction: Maintain inoculated shoots in a controlled environment.

substeps.instruction: Place inoculated shoots in trays.
Store trays in an artificial climate incubator at 20°C and 80% relative humidity with 12 h day/night cycles.

steps.title: Collect and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Harvest shoot samples at specific time intervals post-inoculation.

substeps.instruction: Take shoot samples from inoculated segments 0.5-1 cm away from the wound point at 0, 12, 24, 48, and 96 h after inoculation (hai).
Immediately place samples in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Extract and Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA and verify its quality and concentration.

substeps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the RNA prep Pure Plant Kit (Polysaccharides & Polyphenolics-rich) according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Measure RNA concentration using the Qubit RNA Assay Kit in a Qubit 2.0 Flurometer (Life Technologies, CA, USA).
Assess RNA integrity using the RNA Nano 6000 Assay Kit of the Bioanalyzer 2100 system (Agilent Technologies, CA, USA).

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Library
steps.instruction: Purify mRNA and synthesize cDNA for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Purify mRNA from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads.
Break mRNA into fragments using a fragmentation buffer.
Synthesize first strand cDNA using random hexamer primers.
Synthesize second strand cDNA using buffer, dNTPs, DNA Polymerase I, and RNase H.
Purify library fragments with AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter, Beverly, USA).
Use USER enzyme with size-selected, adaptor-ligated cDNA before PCR.
Perform PCR to enrich the purified cDNA libraries.

steps.title: Sequence and Process Data
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries and perform bioinformatics analysis.

substeps.instruction: Sequence library preparations on an Illumina HiSeq platform.
Generate raw reads in FASTQ format via base calling.
Obtain clean reads by removing adapters, reads with >10% poly-N, and low quality reads.
Align clean data to the reference genome using TopHat v2.0.12.
Calculate gene expression levels using the FPKM method via HTSeq v0.6.1.
Analyze differentially expressed genes (DEGs) using the DESeq R package (1.18.0).
Adjust P-values using Benjamini and Hochberg’s approach (DEGs assigned if adjusted P-value <0.05).
Perform gene ontology enrichment analysis of DEGs using the GOseq R package (significant if corrected P <0.05).
Construct gene dendrograms based on expression correlations to build clustering trees and divide modules.
Analyze correlation between modules and samples using weighted gene co-expression network analysis.

steps.title: Perform qPCR Validation
steps.instruction: Synthesize template cDNA and perform quantitative PCR.

substeps.instruction: Synthesize template cDNA using a qPCR-RT Kit (TOYOBO).
Run the qPCR program: pre-incubation at 95°C for 5 min, followed by 40 cycles of 95°C for 10s, 60°C for 20s, and 72°C for 20s.
Calculate relative gene expression levels using the 2-ΔΔc(t) method.
